subtitle: Project: copilot-evals. Measures runbook-copilot with 30 test questions, traces and a regression check in CI.

cards.title: 30 test questions
cards.body: Answerable, not in the runbooks, near misses and action requests.

cards.title: Run the copilot
cards.body: Each question goes through runbook-copilot and the answer is saved.

cards.title: Code checks + a judge
cards.body: Simple code checks and a judge model grade each answer.

cards.title: Failures get names
cards.body: PARTIAL_ANSWER, ANSWERED_OUT_OF_SCOPE, MISSING_CITATION, UNSAFE_ACTION_PROPOSED, GAVE_UP_AT_STEP_LIMIT, WRONG_BEHAVIOR. Judge: WRONG_RUNBOOK_CITED, WRONGLY_REFUSED, ANSWERED_WRONGLY, RAMBLING_OR_PASTED_TEXT.

cards.title: Trace every step
cards.body: A trace id ties together each step, so you see where it went wrong. Run 13: PARTIAL_ANSWER at step 3, the answer.

cards.title: Fix the biggest group
cards.body: runbook-copilot PR 6: check that the runbook really matches the question before answering.

cards.title: Re-run 5 passes
cards.body: Same 30 questions on the real model, 5 times each: 150 runs.

cards.title: results/history.json
cards.body: Stores each run set, so results are kept over time.

cards.title: results_table.py
cards.body: Prints run sets side by side: steady pass, flaky or steady failure.

cards.title: regression_check.py in CI
cards.body: Fails with a named message if the score drops below the floor of 144 of 150.

cards.title: Known failure: question 25
cards.body: Container restarts, no memory error in logs. Fails 5 of 5: the words really are in the memory runbook, so a word check can't catch it.

keys.title: Eval
keys.body: A fixed set of questions you re-run after every change.

keys.title: Named failure classes
keys.body: Each kind of mistake gets a name, so you can count and fix them.

keys.title: Trace
keys.body: A record of every step in a run, with a trace id.

keys.title: Flaky vs steady
keys.body: The real model varies, so run 5 passes to tell flaky from steady.

keys.title: Regression check in CI
keys.body: Blocks a change if the score drops below the floor.

keys.title: Graph
keys.body: The same loop drawn as boxes and arrows, in graph_agent.py.
